segments.name: Liquor retail
segments.description: Sells wines, beers and spirits to consumers through the Company's owned liquor stores.
segments.evidence: Liquor retail includes the sale of wines, beers and spirits through owned liquor stores.

segments.name: Cannabis retail
segments.description: Sells adult-use cannabis products and accessories to consumers through corporate-owned, controlled and franchised retail cannabis stores.
segments.evidence: Cannabis retail includes the private sale of adult-use cannabis products and accessories through corporate-owned, controlled and franchised retail cannabis stores.

segments.name: Cannabis operations
products: cannabis for the adult-use and medical markets
segments.description: Cultivates, distributes and sells cannabis for domestic adult-use and medical markets and export, and provides processing and consumer packaged goods.
segments.evidence: Cannabis operations include the cultivation, distribution and sale of cannabis for the adult-use and medical markets domestically and for export, and providing proprietary cannabis processing services, in addition to product development, manufacturing, and commercialization of cannabis consumer packaged goods.

segments.name: Investments
segments.description: Deploys the Company's capital into investment opportunities, including its equity-accounted joint venture.
segments.evidence: Investments include the deployment of capital to investment opportunities.

revenueModel.text: Consumers pay for liquor, cannabis and accessories in stores; provincial boards and export buyers pay for cannabis supplied by cannabis operations.
revenueModel.evidence: Cannabis operations include the cultivation, distribution and sale of cannabis for the adult-use and medical markets domestically and for export, and providing proprietary cannabis processing services, in addition to product development, manufacturing, and commercialization of cannabis consumer packaged goods.
